Easy to use, easy to clean, and reusable. Combine these with a Keurig Mini and an Sboly electric burr grinder (also available through Amazon) to make your own quick and easy coffee that tastes better than most popular K-cup brands, while creating less waste. I use Kirkland Signature House Blend whole beans from the place that sells Kirkland Signature products. For the grind, I use a medium-to-fine grind from the aforementioned grinder.

Note that the mesh on these does let some of the smallest particles through, though I haven't had any issues with it hampering the flavor or texture as long as I don't drain the dregs.

I purchased this so that I could use it to froth my milk for homemade lattes and it does not disappoint. It keeps the milk SUPER hot and the frothing that happens in the cup as opposed to a regular coffee cup are AMAZING. I love that it has the internal markings so that I can measure out my milk then heat it up in the pan for my latte's. The handle is very sturdy and helps to keep the heat away from my hand when pouring my frothed milk into my coffee. The precise-pour drip less spout does just that and I am extremely impressed with it because most products that claim they have a drip less spout fall short. This product is highly recommended if you enjoy to make your coffee at home.

There's nothing to love about this pretty little pitcher! I've been trying to learn how to pour latte art on my own for some time bow, and I've always had some problems with controlling loose drops of milk from falling out and spoiling the designs I've poured. In the photos I've attached, you can see the little dip at the tip of the spout, which is missing in the old one that I have. I believe this is the main difference, as the pouring of the milk is really smooth with this pitcher, and I hardly have issues with loose drops now!

In addition, I feel that the markings on the inside of the pitcher helps a lot too, which is also probably the main selling feature of this pitcher. While I have not used it long enough to test if it really is made of stainless steel, I believe that the best way to care for it is to skip the dishwasher, and to wash it with a soft sponge to prevent scratches. All in all, I have nothing to complain about this, it's a really lovely pitcher to pour latte art with :)

While I have received this product at a discount for my honest opinion, I hope that my review of the product has helped you in your decision to purchase this pitcher.
